body.name: Potion of Invisibility
body.description: Become invisible when used. The spell is broken when the target moves or performs an action.
body.effect: Gain invisibility for 17 seconds. When you move, perform an action or take damage, the effect is removed.

body.name: Iron Chain
body.description: A thick iron chain left untouched for years. Its rusted surface gives off a sharp, metallic stench.

body.name: Iron Ingot
body.description: A highly enriched ingot of pure iron.

body.name: Iron Ore
body.description: A dirty chunk of rock containing traces of iron.

body.name: Iron Powder
body.description: Powder made by finely grinding iron ore.

body.name: Jellyfish Glow Essence
body.description: A gelatinous fluid harvested from a luminous jellyfish. It emits its own light in darkness, its brightness undiminished even in the deepest seas.
